title: Chi's Sweet Home
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A newborn kitten, Chi, gets separated from her mother on a walk and is taken in by a boy named Yohei and his parents, the Yamadas. Their apartment does not allow pets, so the family has to keep her quietly while she explores the world from a kitten's point of view. Short, full-color comic chapters follow her everyday discoveries.
life_message: A warm home, patience and affection make a family, including its smallest member.
